notes: Pay and meeting schedule are not stated on the page. Neutral Zone is at 310 E Washington St, Ann Arbor, phone (734) 214-9995.
name: Washtenaw County Youth Commission
org: Washtenaw County Youth Commission (run through the Neutral Zone)
what_you_do: Talk about problems that affect teens. Learn about your community. Suggest changes and new programs to the county leaders.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 18. The commission has 21 members: 2 from each county district and 3 at-large.
deadline_text: Application timeline not posted. The page says to contact Britt Baron at britt@neutral-zone.org.
how_to_apply: Email britt@neutral-zone.org. Ask when you can apply.
